title: How to Verify Monitor Power and Input
overview: Help a reviewer support the Verify Monitor Power and Input step without changing the workflow automatically.
checklist: Verify the monitor's power connection, power button, and confirm the active input source (e.g., HDMI 1, DisplayPort) matches the computer's connection. Ensure the monitor is not in standby mode.
common_indicators: Record the observed result and return to the originating workflow.

answers: Record the result and return to the workflow
